steps.text: Tap the Share button {shareLocation}
Scroll and tap "Add to Home Screen"
Tap "Add" in the top right
Launch from your home screen for fullscreen mode
Open this page in Safari — the steps below are Safari's
Tap the Share button {shareLocation}
Scroll and tap "Add to Home Screen"
Tap "Add" in the top right
Launch from your home screen for fullscreen mode
Tap the menu (three dots)
Tap "Install app" or "Add to Home screen"
Follow the prompts
Launch from your home screen for fullscreen mode
In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon at the end of the address bar — or open the browser menu and choose "Install Splotch"
In Safari on macOS Sonoma or later, choose File → Add to Dock
Follow the prompts
Launch it from your dock, desktop, or taskbar for fullscreen mode
Go to Settings → Accessibility → Guided Access
Turn on Guided Access
Set a passcode
Open Splotch and triple-click the side button
Tap Start to lock the app
Triple-click and enter passcode to exit
Go to Settings → Security → App Pinning
Turn on App Pinning
Open Splotch and tap the Recent Apps button
Swipe up on Splotch and tap the Pin icon
Tap Start to lock the app
Long-press Back + Recent Apps to exit
Install Splotch above, so it opens in its own window with no tabs or address bar
Put the browser in full screen — F11 on Windows and Linux, Control-Command-F on a Mac
Stay nearby — a keyboard can leave the app at any time
Triple-click the side button (or Home button)
Enter your Guided Access passcode
Tap End in the top left
Touch and hold Back + Recent Apps together
(or swipe up and hold, then tap Unpin)
Splotch is now unlocked
